title: Learn anything
subtitle: Type a topic. Pip plans the direction with you, then writes a substantial course around your time and learning preferences.
anythingGoes: Cooking chemistry, tax basics, a programming language. Anything goes.
coursesShowHere: Courses Pip makes for you show up here. Only you can see them.

form.topicLabel: What do you want to learn?
form.topicPlaceholder: e.g. How the stock market works
examples: How vaccines train your immune system
form.whyLabel: Why do you want to learn this?
form.whyHint: Optional. Pip picks examples that fit.
form.whyPlaceholder: e.g. I start an internship at a bank next month
form.timeLabel: How much time do you have?
form.timeHint: Pip fits the number of lessons to this budget.
form.lessonCountHint: Leave it on automatic to derive the count from your time.
form.styleHint: Choose the teaching style that keeps you engaged.
form.formatHint: This controls the mix of reading, slides and practice.
form.assessmentLabel: How do you want to check your learning?
form.assessmentHint: Pip chooses activities and a final check that match this.
form.planningTitle: Pip is planning the course direction…
form.planningNote: You will review the framework before the full lessons are written.
form.writingNote: Short lessons plus a few activities. You will land on it when it is ready.
form.limitReached: That is {limit} courses today. Pip can make more tomorrow.

generate.title: Pip is writing your course
generate.subtitle: The framework is approved. Pip writes one substantial lesson at a time so you can see progress.
generate.waiting: Writing the next lesson… This can take a minute.
generate.ready: Ready to write the next lesson.
generate.error: Pip stopped while writing a lesson.

outline.outcomesTitle: What you will be able to do
outline.approveNote: Pip will write the full lessons and activities from this framework.
outline.adjustNote: Tell Pip what to change; only the framework is regenerated, not the full course.
outline.adjustPlaceholder: e.g. more real-world examples, less theory, a harder final task
outline.limitError: You have reached today's course limit. Try again tomorrow.

feedback.readyNote: Open it, try an activity, then come back and tell Pip what to improve.
feedback.title: How was the course?
feedback.subtitle: Your feedback shapes the next generation; it is not just a rating.
feedback.commentPlaceholder: e.g. more examples, less jargon, a harder final task
feedback.lessonFeedbackLabel: What should change in this lesson?
feedback.lessonFeedbackPlaceholder: e.g. explain the example more slowly
